notes.title: Demo Update! - v0.9.6
notes.notes:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators!



I hope you missed us a lot, because I for sure missed coming here to tell you that we have a new demo update!



We’ve worked a lot on this one, I mean, work is all we actually can do here. And now the build we made to surprise living souls at Gamescom Latam 2025 (and in our “Free Labor Day” Discord event) is finally within reach to all of you!



Actually, we went a little overboard with the fixes and suggestions noted during the event and have already implemented a lot of them! So if you were amongst the thousands of eager living souls that [strike]worked for us[/strike] played the game during the event, there's new stuff here for you as well!


Demo Update
Yeah yeah, there is a really big changelog with all of the updates and additions listed at the end, but a couple of highlights will help you see the juicy parts first. But if you hate spoilers and love reading, feel free to just skip ahead in the post to find this update’s changelog. Otherwise, here are some key changes to this version:


Updated FeaturesStage Selection Screen
Yeap, with this snazzy new screen, after you’ve selected who you’re working as in the Outfit Selection Screen, you will also choose the stage/location you will work at that time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/62ba3f75d62e6d0801ace9a7c19d551166398b50.png"]
Two new stages
You’ve read this right [strike]or maybe not, I don’t know what you can actually read[/strike], TWO new stages, in a way.

Now you’re not confined to the company’s private graveyard and recruitment site, now you can [strike]invade[/strike] expand your work activities into two new places: a really calm village and a really busy mine! With this update, you’ll be able to explore the calm village in a forest with a lot of boars, and after beating the local Hero there, you’ll unlock the cool experience of delving into the depths of the kingdom’s most important mine, full of new enemies and profitable souls! 

Don’t reading about it gets your capitalist soul shivering with anticipation?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/e7f62d1b55a35d80617b524122fc7f69f5eab2e2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/d7d3624e5b16852e62d58d6328bb7d4f22bfb5ad.png"]
Save Safeguard
One of the problems some of you living souls were facing was “how do I reset my save file or guarantee it is updated?” well, Upper Management has heard your feedback and acted upon it (ironic, considering they always ignore mine)!  Now whenever you open the Demo, it will check to see if your save file is up-to-date considering the version you are playing at the moment, and if you are outdated it will prompt you with a choice to delete your save file to prevent any issues. 

Yeah, for now our only solution to protect your save is to kill it, who would’ve thought? You also have the option to manually decide to delete your save and start anew in the main menu, if you decide to do so for whatever strange reason you living souls have.

Oh, and don't worry! Despite highly recommended, resetting your save is optional. In fact, if you do choose to reset it, you can even choose to keep half of your previous Eternal Scrips total.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif"]



There are actually a couple of other things we’re working on at the moment that will enhance the experience even further, but Management has told us to hold on to those for a little while because, and I quote “Don’t spoil them too much otherwise they will start demanding actual payment”. But Bard said he is almost convincing them to let us give you those new things as well, but who knows if he’s saying the truth or just boasting?



And as always: yes, the update is live right now! So get to work! And don’t worry, if you have any problems, doubts, suggestions or just want to chat with us, we are always available on our Discord server, which you can join through the demo’s main menu. Our marketing team reinforced that it was good for the company if our Discord was more “alive”, and I find this offensive. But please feel free to give us a hello over there!



And that’s it for this news-update. Thank you so much for your overwhelming support and understanding! The reception during the live events with this build was incredible, so we think you’ll love it as well.



E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif"]


Changelog v0.9.6New Content
1 new Spell Evolution

5 new Boons

1 new Artifact

1 new Talent

2 new Stages
New Enemies
Crystal Golems - "They were once men..." ..or something like that. Don't let their beautiful and valuable magical crystal shell fool you, what's truly valuable is what's inside! Yes, I mean their souls.

Exploding Spiders - "Now twice as dreadful!" ... Seriously, don't let these things get near you. If even the living are blast into pieces, just imagine how far they can scatter our bones when they go boom.

And more dangers for you to find!
Changes
Evolutions!

Some spells and weapons can now be evolved into stronger versions of themselves after reaching max level and having certain boons

A proper in-game guide on evolutions will be added at a later date

Spell Reworks!

Our spells and weapons are currently being reworked to improve lots of stuff and add new technical possibilities (new behaviours, performance, etc)

Orbit Spell can now scale with both projectile size and area size, increase the radius at which it spins around you

Magic Missile's target tracking was improved

Added a Stage Select screen!

Added 2 new Stages!

Stages now have proper lighting, animated objects and VFXs

Added Chest Indicators!

 Dropped chests' position will now be indicated in the UI if they are outside of your screen

Added Tooltips!

You can now check more info about Stats and Status Effects during Boon Selection / Level Up

The stats displayed across boons and artifacts have been standardised to the same color to avoid that confusing green / red text that didn't mean an upgrade nor downgrade to a stat

Added new animated character portrait expressions!

Added new dialogues

Added an "Outfit Unlocked" popup for when you unlock new Character Outfits

Added names and health bars to Adventurers and some special enemies

Reworked most boons and artifacts' descriptions for improved clarity

Reworked some UI Elements to improve visual clarity

Reworked some Talents' icons

Faye's Talent Screen has received yet more visual updates

Reworked the generic UI button for improved visibility

Level Up Screen's header is now dynamic and reacts to what's happening during the level up process

Added a language toggle in the main menu's top right corner to more quickly swap the language if necessary

Added SFXs to some UI elements that were silent
Balancing
The pickup range talent now has 5 levels instead of 3.

A Specific Magical Railgun - Only half of additional Attack Speed is now applied to Damage Multiplier instead of a 1:1

Reality-bending Lens: Projectile Size bonus reduced from 100% to 50%. However, now half of your additional Projectile Size is also applied to your Damage Multiplier

Retro 3D Glasses: Projectile Size bonus reduced from 50% to 40%

Orb of Limitless Ponderation: Exp Multiplier reduced from 60% to 55%

Alcabone's Guidance now also increases Pickup Range by 30%

Projectile Case changed from Common to Uncommon

Profane Aura's base area size increased from 1.2 to 1.3
Fixes
Improved many systems' performance and stability

Fixed a severe logic issue with some stats multiplication leading to wrong math

Fixed several bugs with the boss

Fixed Boss's SFXs being super loud

Fixed the boss entering a loop of using the same ability over and over again if you leveled up while he was casting one of his abilities

Fixed stats not updating immediately in the lobby after you upgrade / downgrade talents

Fixed Stat Conversion artifacts not immediately applying the conversion after being picked up

Fixed some other localization issues

Fixed some typos

Fixed some Lobby elements not being affected by lights

Fixed boons on the Current Boons Screen displaying stat key names instead of translated text

Fixed an issue with the HP logic that could lead to the HP bar not representing the player's current HP correctly

Fixed an issue with UI navigation that sometimes prompted errors when closing menus

Reworked some logic involving enemy projectiles and fixed the player not taking damage from them under some circumstances

Reworked and improved the Level Up logic and flow.

Reworked and improved the Revive logic. Also fixed the VFX sometimes happening twice

Reworked and improved the Boon pool system

  This has improved which boons can appear and when, as well as fixed a couple of issues when trying to draw certain boons

Fixed some SFXs playing on wrong parts of the UI

Fixed some SFXs not playing on some parts of the UI

Fixed the weapon list's scroll in the results screen not working with the mouse

Fixed the buttons in the results screen losing their reference while playing with a controller and forcing you to click on them with the mouse

And so, so, so much more... (I miss vacations...)

notes.title: Update 0.9.5b - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators!

According to our living-world calendars, it must be the beginning of 2025 for you, give or take 10 years. 

So to kick things off, here's our first update of 2025 (or whatever silly year it is over there now), which has been in the works since the beginning of last month. And let me tell you, it's packed to the bone!

But before that, Inhuman Resources demanded I gave a spotlight on some of the things that are included in this update!

New Boss HP Bar
Boss enemies now have their HP displayed at all times to make sure you notice when the boss spawns (and dies!). It should also help you realize when you accidentally kill them off-screen now (since you've been doing that so often, you hard-working soul).

Revamped Talents Screen
Ms.Faye is working on some new stuff! She mentioned something about new talents and some features being held back by Inhuman Resources for further analysis, so they might still take a while to be available for general use (but you can catch a glimpse of them in there now).

Revamped Dialogue Box UI
The Dialogue Box UI has received yet another round of upgrades, looking more sleek, responsive (especially for keyboard and controller navigation, whatever that means), and beautiful. It should also improve the visualization of what option you are currently selecting.

Overall New Content!
Of course, there are new boons, artifacts, talents, and even new enemies! Get out there and try them out for yourself (it is not an option, the boss kinda demands it)!

And that's about it!
Please look forward to upcoming updates, we are being worked to death to get them to you.

E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

Changelog v0.9.5b
New Content
New Boons & Artifacts
- Box of Unread CVs - Increases Exp Gain by 3% and Critical Chance by 1%
- Nepotist's Special Blend - Increases Move Speed by 5%, Attack Speed by 20% and Dash Charges by 1, but reduces Health by 10%
- Mobile Game Ad - Increases Projectile Duration by 5%, but reduces HP Regen by 1%
- Edgy Cosplay - Increases Base Damage by 2, Damage Multiplier by 20% and Attack Speed by 20%, but reduces Exp Gain by 20%
- Pocket Particle Accelerator - Increases Projectile Speed by 120%, but reduces Projectile Duration by 20%
- Indestructible Pager - Increases Base Damage and Armor by 0.6
- Shiba Plushie - Increases HP Regen by 12%
- Sunstone - Increases Base Damage and HP by 40%
- And more!

New Enemies
- Golden Boar - Rare special enemy that gives a lot of exp and guarantees a chest drop

Changes
- Added more spawn points for adventurers and bosses! They'll no longer only spawn on the top right corner of the screen
- Revamped the dialogue options' UI to make it clearer which option you currently have selected
- Revamped the icons of some older boons
- Revamped the art of swordsman adventurers (with others to follow soon)
- Slightly increased Fireball's minimum size cap to avoid it getting too tiny
- Reintroduced the Domain Expansion boon to the pool
- Several UI improvements across all screens / menus
- Heavily improved UI controller navigation
- Improvements to the Dialogue Box UI

Rebalances
- Increased the Boss's HP and Armor scaling
- Exp Gain Boon - Now has 3 levels instead of 4
- Improved the chance of Poison Aura appearing during boon selection
- Automatic Vaccum Cleaner - Now reaches 100% in 2 levels instead of 3
- Slightly reduced enemy scaling past 15 minutes / after the Boss is defeated

Fixes
- Fixed an issue with the stat upgrade formula that led to certain boons increasing some stats by way more than they should
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't confirm your selection with the controller on the Character Select screen
- Fixed the Transmute Talent increasing a Reroll charge instead of a Transmute one, which led to 6 Reroll charges and 4 Transmute charges instead of 5 and 5 when both talents were maxed
- Fixed the red part of the Boss's HP Bar not being displayed
- Fixed an issue where the dialogue options didn't display correctly when more than 1 option was available
- Fixed boon descriptions in the tooltips at Current Boons and Results Screen displaying localization keys instead of the actual localized stat
- Fixed boon tooltips displaying wrong fonts
- Fixed some minor font issues
- Fixed some buttons not having any sort of indication they were being highlighted or selected
- Fixed exp bar's "Level" text not reflecting the chosen localisation option until you picked up a soul
- Fixed the next dialogue indicator not changing to controller buttons when the Intern was talking

Known Issues
- Performance still drops when running late game builds with lots of projectiles.
- Some weapons still have weird behaviours, namely Hate 2.O, but may apply to others
- Can't see collected Artifacts on the Boons Screen
- Can't use the mouse to scroll on the combat statistics list on the result screen (using W/S keys or a controller both work at the moment)
- Controller / Keyboard navigation in the new Delete Save option can lose reference of the selected button, making it impossible to interact with it. A mouse is likely required for interacting with it at the moment (we're working on a fix!)

notes.title: Update 0.9.5a - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators!

We've managed to squeeze another "tiny" update right before you mortals celebrate the holidays!

Enjoy the festivities and be sure to let us know if you find any further bugs with the Mortician Update. Management said our developers would be delighted to fix them asap since we have no holidays over here.

E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

New Boons

New Talents
6 new talents that affect the following stats:

 Projectile Duration
 Projectile Size
 Projectile Speed

notes.title: Demo Update - The Mortician Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings esteemed collaborators!

It’s been a hot minute, but we’re delighted to finally be able to announce that we have a new demo update!

Management wanted me to make a whole mystery about it, but who has time for that? Not me, I’m overworked.

So let’s talk about the “Mortician Demo Update”!

Mortician Demo Update
If you’re up to date with our latest announcements, these will be of no surprise for you, so feel free to just skip ahead in the post to find this update’s Changelog. But if you’re not aware of our previous sneak-peaks, here are some key changes to this version:

Updated Features
Character Selection
Previously you had to actually TALK to your coworkers to change into their clothes and work as them. But aside from the fact you’d be changing clothes in the middle of the office, honestly: who actually wants to talk with their colleagues every single time? Not this skeleton. Now we have an actual locker room dedicated to giving you the privacy you need while selecting whichever collaborator you want to pretend to be that time and directly go to work on the field. And you can even compare stats to boost, no more blind picks!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/0ee325ca5722048bda74d6444b280aeaafcaed25.gif

Boon Selection
One of the best perks of working here is the wide array of boons to our collaborators on the field, we know this and so do you. But we noticed that some living souls didn’t 100% understand all the differences in importance and types (yeah, management hears your feedback, just not mine), so it was all revamped to help even the newest of interns to comprehend it all!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/bc9ac1e8ae9a4b41aa69817560c8de868b3db80e.gif

New Mechanics
Status Effects 
Even though Warrior loves focusing only on pure damage, we know that [strike]killing[/strike] collecting human souls sometimes asks for a more refined approach… like poison. So now some Boons will help you by adding a probability that your damage can also apply Poison, Burning or a Curse (which lowers the enemy’s defense temporarily) to all the living souls!

PS: Rogue told me that our R&D department has a lot more on this feature in the works, and that only an initial version of it was released, so you can expect a more in-depth status effects system soon (I guess)!

Updated Visuals
Level Up 
Leveling up has never been this satisfying! There’s a whole new VFX to properly indicate when you level up, as well as to make it clear how it is that the enemies were being pushed back whenever it happened.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/162a4659a3fd4c02661bda94483798b5deca17b3.gif

Unstable Phylactery / Revive
Yes, this artifact is incredible. And yes, we know you couldn’t tell when it activated because there was no visual indicator. Now whenever you [strike]are killed[/strike] start an overtime shift you can clearly see it activating, getting you back to work and wiping the screen off of enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/9d1992a244c56ff7c70d5c830037ca0b7ece20d5.gif

New Boons
You know what? I’m not gonna spoon-feed this part with my slick note-taking skills, you can check out the changelog at the end of this post if you want to read about all the new Boons!

And I assure you that they will greatly aid you during your runs. Especially that aura stuff…

Anyway...

As of this post, it is now Friday the 13th of this month! We were told this date holds some significance for you living souls when talking about the undead and overall horrors, so we thought it a perfect date to release our new update!

Yes, the update is live right now! So get to work! And don’t worry, if you have any problems, doubts, suggestions or just want to chat with us, we will be online and ready to help you with some “live” customer-support on our Discord server, which you can join through the demo’s main menu now as well.

We’re already dead enough ourselves, so our marketing team said it was good for the company if our Discord was more “alive”, or whatever that means. So we’re [strike]being forced to[/strike] gladly working on it!

And that’s it for this news-update. Thank you so much for your overwhelming support and understanding! We will by happily waiting for all of you on our Demonstration Day (not like we have a choice). See you soon!

E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif

Changelog
New Content
New Spells

 Poison Aura
 • Creates an area around you that deals damage to enemies inside it. Can't Crit
 Recluse's Aura
 • Creates an area around you that pushes enemies away from you every 3s. Doesn't deal damage

New Boons

 • Increases Projectile Speed by 50%, but reduces Projectile Duration by 50%
 Knock-off Supplies (Uncommon)
 • Increases Damage Multiplier by 5% and Knockback Strength by 5%

 • Increases Armor by 10 and Move Speed by 10%
Vacation Voucher (Common)
 • Increases Health by 2% and Health Regen by 0.2
 And more!

New Artifacts

New Talents

 Dash Invulnerability

Changes

 Added a Character Selection Screen and improved the process of starting a new run
 • Due to this, you can no longer change to an NPC's outfit in the lobby by speaking with them, nor can you start a run by speaking with the NPC beside the elevator
 Reworked and improved the Boon Selection Screen
 Slightly reworked the Dialogue Box UI to improve readability and avoid confusion with the Skip button
 Made many small visual changes to the Lobby
 The Janitor is back at work! He's still not very friendly or talkative, but he can be found in the Lobby
 Added a VFX for when the player revives
 Reworked and improved the VFX that plays when you level up
 Many balancing changes to boons, spells, weapons and enemies
 The Reaper's Scythe artifact now has a cap for its damage increase
 • It now also increases your HP based on how many enemies you kill after you pick this artifact
 Added new icon art for boons and artifacts that still had either placeholder or duplicate art
 The Dash button should no longer be indicated alongside the movement and pause button indicators when you start a run if you don't have it unlocked yet (we're sorry for the confusion it caused!)

 Changed the size of many text boxes across all screens to improve readability and avoid huge differences between text sizes (especially when changing languages)
 Added a "Join our Discord!" button and a "Wishlist Now!" button to the Main Menu

Fixes

 Fixed the Lock Camera option in the settings menu

 Fixed Blizzard spell not levelling up to Level 8 like most spells
 Fixed Rogue's Dash Cooldown being much quicker than everyone else's
 Fixed the main weapons not updating their stats until being leveled up again
 Fixed some issues with the controller support
 Fixed many localization issues for the PT-BR language version
 Fixed several font-related issues for texts on the PT-BR language version
 Fixed some screens and texts not being translated
 Fixed several bugs on the Talent Screen
 Dozens of other bug fixes

Known Issues

 Clicking on a dialogue to make the text be revealed all at once can sometimes advance to the next dialogue instead of waiting to display the current one's full text. We're working on a fix as we speak (type?)!
 The boss can sometimes move awkwardly after using his jump attack. Good for you, bad for balancing, I suppose... Working on a fix!
 Some UI elements have missing SFXs or are mistakenly using SFXs from other UI elements. Also working on it!

notes.title: Development Update - October 2024
notes.notes:
Greetings esteemed collaborators!

We've returned with a few updates since the release of our first demo, and this time we have some mixed news—some exciting and cool, and some... not as much (but trust me, it’ll all be worth it!).

Let’s talk Demo Updates and Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif

So, to address the skeleton-elephant in the room:

Upper Management has hit a few bumps over the past couple of months, leading to unexpected delays and schedule changes. Due to that, we'll be extending the time between Demo Updates and, unfortunately, pushing our Early Access release to early 2025. 

But fear not, dear mortals! We’re working our unpaid-best to get everything back on track as soon as possible!

We can't share all the details due to respecting personal privacy (after all, we’re not one of those ruthless corporations that sell your data), but rest assured, we’re all well. We just need a bit more time to sort things out. Thank you for your understanding!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/78703fd912d7fb2d153d50a767cb49bda241c55e.png

But we’re not letting this message end in a low-note, so I asked Rogue to “borrow” some sneak-peeks of what you can expect in the next Demo Update. Remember to thank the “nice” skeleton after this:

Demo Build Name: “Mortician”
Update focus: Visual and handling experience (what the heavens does this mean??)

Revamped Screens & UI Improvements
As spoiled in a previous post, some screens have been completely revamped with beautiful and informative additions, and they'll be in this demo very soon! No more having to directly talk to your coworkers to choose working for them, now you can simply borrow their clothes from the locker room!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/0ee325ca5722048bda74d6444b280aeaafcaed25.gif

And if you remember the last preview of the upcoming revamped Boon Selection screen, here is a GIF of it working in-game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/bc9ac1e8ae9a4b41aa69817560c8de868b3db80e.gif
I did the math and it is at least 106.66% cooler!

Less Confusing Dialog Box UI
Another thing we've noticed is that many mortals have been getting confused by the skip button and where to actually click to progress the dialog, which caused many of you to skip dialog unintentionally.

So to fix that, we're trying out some slight changes to the Dialog Box UI. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/62025dd9a185b46739e4a6544dfe1b372a3049b3.gif
Hopefully you'll find it clearer than before, but if you don't, do let us know so we can [strike]get shouted at for failing again[/strike] improve it even further!

New Content
To be honest, I don’t know how much content they'll let me spoil and how much will be redacted.

More Boons!
I've been having a blast testing these out, and trust me, REDACTED and REDACTED are great additions! Just look at these cool boons:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/5e9eaf1578775c2c0f3dc729b89ff9285478d5bc.png
Oh, and did you know that the demo has many boons that aren't currently available in the pool of options? I've heard some of them have been either reworked or fixed and should be reintroduced (or should I say introduced since you didn't see them yet?) to the pool in the next update too!

New Enemies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/82dd0ecfb14708f4916d06a0c8fbae3c391abdb5.gif
You know what they say: "A man's entertainment is another's extra shift" - or something like that...

Anyway, I was told you'd be happy to know that more Adventurers have been accepting quests nearby, so they might show up in the Graveyard soon. Yay...

New Talents & Discounts!
There are new Talents available, so be sure to talk to Miss Faye on the next update and check them out!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/5f1a891d65db690135873f63df9e97dcea7c4240.png

Oh, and it seems we've finally managed to convince her to charge less for some Talents, especially considering some of them weren't even working correctly in the first place... Which she also assured me should be fixed in the next update as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif

I’ll stop with the spoilers here because Rogue said he will start charging me at this point, and I’m already deep in debt. So if you want to know more, feel free to talk directly to Management in our Discord Server! 

You can use that space to hear all about the development, share your ideas and even compete with other mortals to see who gets the best results during their shifts (yay, free labor!).

And that’s it for this update. Thanks for your overwhelming support and understanding, we promise to work ourselves to the bone to give you the best experience! And keep an eye open for the next posts, it shouldn’t take long.

E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

notes.title: First update post of the year!
notes.notes:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators! 2024 is finally here... Wait, what do you mean it’s been three months?! I’m pretty sure I read management’s previous notice just last week… Well, apologies for that. I suppose the notion of time is different when you're [strike]overworked[/strike] undead.

In any case, this is my first actual post here since Undead Resources [strike]dumped their workload[/strike] gave me this incredible opportunity to gain experience [strike]with no actual pay increase[/strike]!

This is finally the year where E-Lich: Corporate Souls will be available for all you lucky people from the mortal realm (which will hopefully increase our profits and let me actually have a salary). So with that said, I hope you're well and rested, because we're here today to show you our latest updates (which will mean more work for you and I very soon)!

The Talent Manager
Someone in the office told me our first trailer lacked “life”. It took me a good while to understand, but I’m pretty sure they meant the fact that Miss Faye was kept out of it. Yeah, that’s probably it.

Anyway, meet Faye, The Talent Manager!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/b805e87493756cfad42200619cba4349ce224c21.gif
She’s the only living being in our company and is treated better than all of us, or so I heard. Mysteriously enough, upper management allows her to go on vacation multiple times a year. I wonder what one must do to get such a nice treatment…

Whenever she’s in office, however, she’ll be able to help you improve your talents! From brute force to life steal, she can grant you many useful power-ups. Rogue told me that “it’ll just cost the majority of your salary, but it’s absolutely worth it!” - What a steal!

Bug Fixes
Since the last update we’ve been working on several bug fixes in order to prepare for our Demo release, which if I heard the gossip correctly, should be somewhere around [REDACTED].

By the way, I noticed our developers track their bugs with unique IDs, which is kinda cool. However, seeing “BUG-105” made me unsure if the increasing digits are supposed to be a good thing or a bad thing... 

In any case, they said typing out every bug fix was a waste of time since the Demo wasn’t out yet, so I should just focus on sharing the more interesting news instead. Which reminds me…

Office Renovation
I kept hearing how we were “low on budget” and how that impacted our salaries, so you can imagine my surprise when I walked in one day and they were renovating our entire lobby.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/07b5ba23312b78b3281864d856df3b6b6ae83114.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/cf87eba23d3dc3f8699861d5ed0714b39f46a72a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/3f02492165fbf000f7db3b0e2a64593e22712e7f.png
Dolores keeps denying it, but I’m certain that she knows how much was spent on this little project. Especially considering just how good it looks.

Sprite Visual Overhaul
Speaking of looking good, our employees received a visual overhaul! If I didn't know any better, I'd even say they look more lively.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/6eb2b7616b25fbc7572930d3a4bdb2ae3479f70d.gif
And strangely enough, our enemies too. Their souls still look the same though…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/4c1b7499d15c7d0b6d8ec947661ffe23149b90d7.gif
If you’ve been following our social media as of late you might have caught a glimpse of some of these changes in action. If you haven’t, then be sure to follow us and so you don’t miss out on the latest news!

Twitter - @elichgame
Instagram - @elichgame
TikTok - @elichgame
LinkedIn - elichgame

I’m not sure how our socials manage to get regular posts. I can’t even get a break to drink coffee anymore, much less keeping track of social media… 

Oh, and that reminds me! It seems plans to open a Discord server have been finally set in motion, what with the Demo release talks and all. However, that’s all I’ve heard for the moment, so I’ll update you once they update the gossip about it. 

That’s it for our update! Please keep an eye on our future ones, hopefully I can do more of these if I’m not stuck with overtime. Thanks for reading and keep on living (until we come to collect)!

E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."
